content.introduction: On the Yahoo Finance earnings calendar, several companies are scheduled to announce their earnings for Q3 2026, including Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) and Amgen Inc. (AMGN). The EPS estimates for AMD are $1.94, and for Amgen, it is $5.78. Sysco Corporation (SYY) is also listed with an EPS estimate of $1.19. Marketwatch lists Sumitomo Corp. ADR (SSUMY) with an EPS forecast of $0.23 for the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2026. Stockanalysis.com provides additional details, showing Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) with an EPS estimate of $1.89 and Amgen (AMGN) with an EPS estimate of $5.77, both scheduled to report after the market close.
